feature: Stage J P0 autonomous NPC salvage economy, corporate ISK and Rust recovery
prerequisites: Preserve production evejs-data, run on disposable native SQLite GameStore clone
Both Rust pending and settlement extensions installed and compiled on authorized disposable market server
Native game telemetry enabled, two logged-in clients, authentic NPC salvage origin and physical station
All relevant feature flags remain OFF outside isolated QA

scenarios.name: NPC original physical haul and wreck
scenarios.expected: Real NPC cargo debit and original wreck item ID, no minted loot

scenarios.name: Competing player RESCUE escrow
scenarios.expected: Escrow-reserved original manifest cannot be stolen by NPC salvage rival

scenarios.name: NPC salvager approaches wreck
scenarios.expected: Native movement and combat priorities honored

scenarios.name: NPC original pickup
scenarios.expected: Same original source cargo moves wreck to NPC native cargo in one transaction

scenarios.name: NPC physically delivers station stock
scenarios.expected: Same original proof, native cargo removed, one native corporation item credited at station

scenarios.name: No real Rust bid or ask
scenarios.expected: NPC holds original warehouse item, no market order, virtual income or guessed quote

scenarios.name: Real nonseed station bid
scenarios.expected: NPC prices from same-station Rust native bid and places one pending/open corporate sell order

scenarios.name: Genuine station ask, no bids
scenarios.expected: Bounded competitive asking price with minimum floor, never seed or mismatched station

scenarios.name: Original salvage native market escrow
scenarios.expected: One same itemID moved warehouse to native escrow, one open Rust order, no mint

scenarios.name: Actual docked player buys whole stack
scenarios.expected: Rust locks original claim, same item delivered to buyer, buyer debited once, NPC corp credited once, original marketEscrow deleted

scenarios.name: Actual Rust finalized fill and NPC income
scenarios.expected: GetNpcSellClaim original fillID and buyer, GameStore npcMarketFills, corporate wallet, SOLD journal all agree

scenarios.name: Duplicate listing from two A-Life ticks
scenarios.expected: Existing PREPARED/ESCROWED/LISTED/SOLD durable operation prevents another source order

scenarios.name: Crash after PREPARED before Rust Reserve
scenarios.expected: Read-only Rust Get by operation ID, no blind Reserve or new item; unresolved without trusted order

scenarios.name: Lost Reserve ACK after Rust pending
scenarios.expected: Recover same Rust order and original item to native escrow; no second Reserve

scenarios.name: Crash after native escrow before Activate
scenarios.expected: Get Rust pending, same item escrow, idempotent activate with original operation ID

scenarios.name: Lost Activate ACK
scenarios.expected: Read original Rust open order, seal LISTED, no second native debit

scenarios.name: Crash after native buyer/corp wallet commit before Rust finalize
scenarios.expected: Rust settling + original native fill receipt finishes same Rust claim without second ISK transfer

scenarios.name: Lost Rust finalize ACK after Rust filled
scenarios.expected: Read original Rust filled claim and seal SOLD, wallet changes exactly once

scenarios.name: Stale, forged or duplicated original stock
scenarios.expected: No new Rust order or financial credit, game reports reconciliation block

scenarios.name: Two buyers race same original order
scenarios.expected: One durable original buyer claim, one native item, one wallet transfer

scenarios.name: Enemy attacks NPC while hauling
scenarios.expected: No station return or sales decision overrides higher priority native combat

scenarios.name: Player relog and second client verifies item/wallet
scenarios.expected: Native itemStore and UI update, original sold NPC stock absent, real wallet balances and Rust fill visible

scenarios.name: Disable all new market flags
scenarios.expected: Native salvage auto trade remains OFF; original EveJS market and existing features unaffected

scenarios.name: Pinned overlay apply and revert
scenarios.expected: New native modules present once, upstream restored byte-identically; no touching persistent evejs-data

scenarios.name: Seller tax and fees decision
scenarios.expected: Gross-only corporate sales explicitly disclosed; native tax separate gate before any net-profit acceptance
